scientific_checks.censoring: Conditional hazard likelihood through event/censor endpoint; cumulative death=1-product(1-hazard)
scientific_checks.evidence_boundary: Historical exploratory diagnostic only; no served-gain or fresh-bank inference
scientific_checks.factorial: 480 fixed final-fold units; separate T5 and A5 tables; four encoders; two heads; three nested world doses; two seeds; five folds
scientific_checks.models: Frozen B8 linear control, trainable B8 shape random/init, and 6680134-parameter M D300 model
scientific_checks.scale_kill: M-random minus S-random D300 AUC on full-dose T5 <0.02 AND paired lower95 bound<=0 AND M 50-to-100 percent AUC slope<0.01
scientific_checks.splits: Whole parent worlds remain within one fold; nested 25/50/100 percent training-world prefixes exclude the held-out fold
scientific_checks.statistics: Seed probabilities average before scoring; paired parent-world bootstrap; 2000 resamples; fixed seed
scientific_checks.target_kill: Relative D300 Brier improvement<0.10 keeps single-horizon; equality retains hazards
